g.text: Annual education spending on a student (Rs)
Weighted median education spending is Rs 15,000; the top 10% exceed Rs 60,000
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files (course data repository).
Sample: 4,596 students with annual education spending above zero in Punjab urban; 2 students outside Rs 100-Rs 1,000,000 are excluded.
Weighted by the household weight (hhweight). Bins are 0.1 log10 units wide.
